Asset type: Original standalone horizontal version A Chinese ink-wash painting background for a Linyi cultural page, not a website screenshot.
Creative direction: An imagined Yimeng foothill river scene with the graceful drooping branches of willow, drawing atmospheric inspiration from Linyi's landscape and Linshu willow-weaving tradition, without depicting a real village or a specific artifact. Suggest a small fictional riverside dwelling or distant person beneath willow branches at one edge. Make Chinese brush-and-ink expression primary: confident willow brushstrokes, ink diffusion, dry-brush textures, varied dark-to-pale ink tones and layered washes on xuan paper. Use restrained moss green, ink-black and a hint of warm ivory, not a blue maritime or terracotta kiln scene.
Composition: A few gestural willow branches descend from an upper edge, with a light river winding toward distant ink hills. Leave the central mobile-safe crop visually calm and sufficiently open for later dark text, with details intentionally away from the busiest reading area and no solid crowded band along the bottom. Original, atmospheric and elegant. Horizontal 16:9, highest clear native resolution available.

At one edge include a small whimsical imaginary painted wooden bird or toy form, clearly illustrated and not a real historical object or copy of an existing toy. Build a coherent original hand-printed / carved-wood artistic scene with muted cinnabar, warm honey-yellow, deep ink-blue and walnut-brown. It should look distinctly handmade and graphic, not a photorealistic product picture or generic gradient wallpaper.
Composition: A playful asymmetrical arc of woodgrain and painted carved forms enters from the upper right, fading into a calm low-contrast warm or dark field across the center and left for readable text and mobile cropping. Keep the lower edge spacious. Make it visually and materially different from the moss-green ink landscape A. Horizontal 16:9, highest clear native resolution available.

B 初稿转手绘风的完整调整提示词：

Asset type: An original handcrafted illustrated background for a Linyi cultural page. The supplied image is the edit target.
Single targeted change: Render the bird and curved wood-turned shapes unmistakably as a flat, hand-painted Chinese folk woodblock illustration, with visible printed outlines, hand-applied matte cinnabar and ochre pigments and intentional stylized shapes. The bird is an imaginary drawn toy, never an actual historical object. Remove photorealistic carved-product photography, 3D studio shadows and lifelike object rendering.
Keep the broad asymmetrical composition, woodgrain-inspired circular rhythms, deep ink-blue and warm wood color palette, and quiet dark central reading space. Maintain wide horizontal format.
Constraints: AI creative illustration / imagined toy, not an authentic artifact, real historical fact or documentary photograph. No real people, real places, maps, boundaries, text, numbers, seals, logos, watermarks, QR codes or UI.
